source_file: 了解方位：奇妙的宝盒（5-8岁）.pptx
full_text_zh:
[P1] 蒙特梭利童书
好教育，爱教育
数学来了！
认识前后、左右等空间方位
了解方位
奇妙的宝盒
钟林皎 文  苏虹 绘
金盾出版社

[P2] 可可兔明天要上学了。
兔妈妈说：“在幼儿园里能
交到很多朋友。”兔爸爸说：“在
幼儿园里会过得很开心。”
可可兔好期待明天快快到来。

“明天”来了，天气很好，但是可可兔却不开心。
坐在可可兔左边的是美美鼠，她朝可可兔友好地微笑：“你
好，你的长耳朵好漂亮哦！”
可可兔不喜欢美美鼠的尖嘴巴，所以嘟着嘴不说话。
美美鼠只好转过脸，和趴趴狗一起玩“石头剪刀布”的游戏。

[P3] 坐在可可兔右边的是皮皮猴，他向可可兔微笑着打招呼：
“你好，你的长耳朵真漂亮！”

可可兔不喜欢皮皮猴的长尾巴，所以又嘟着嘴不说话。
皮皮猴只好走开了，和蹦蹦蛙一起去拍小皮球。

下课了，小朋友们有的在玩“老鹰捉小鸡”的游戏，有的在堆积木，
有的在看图画书……只有可可兔一个人孤孤单单地坐在座位上。

[P4] 下午放学，兔妈妈来接可可兔。
可可兔嘟着嘴：“没有人和我一起玩，我没有交到好朋友。”
妈妈温柔地问可可兔发生了什么事情？
“美美鼠和皮皮猴都说我的长耳朵很漂亮。”
“那你是怎么做的呢？”
“我不喜欢美美鼠的尖嘴巴，也不喜欢皮皮猴的长尾巴，我没有理他们。幼儿园不好玩，我不要上幼儿园。”
“哎呀！”兔妈妈拍了一下自己的头，说自己忘记把一件重要的东西交给可可兔，可可兔才会在幼儿园里过得不开心。
兔妈妈回到家，打开一个红色的大箱子，从里面拿出了一个红色的小盒子。
这是什么宝贝呀？
原来这是兔外婆传下来的奇妙宝盒，能吸收快乐能量。
不过，只有可可兔对别人微笑，才能把快乐的能量吸过来。

[P5] 第二天，可可兔带着奇妙宝盒来到幼儿园。
她对左边的美美鼠微笑：“美美鼠，你的尖嘴巴好棒哦，能
咬动很坚硬的东西吧？”
“哈哈，是的。”美美鼠邀请可可兔一起玩积木，她们搭了
一座大大的城堡。

可可兔朝右边的皮皮猴微笑：“皮皮猴，你的长尾巴好棒哦，
一定可以挂在树上荡秋千吧？”
“哈哈，是的！”皮皮猴邀请可可兔一起捉迷藏。
可可兔还没有找到地方藏起来，教室外面传来一阵可怕的声音。
吼吼吼……

[P6] 吼吼吼，吼吼吼——
啊，是一只喷火龙！
小朋友们吓坏了。皮皮猴、蹦蹦蛙和
趴趴狗跳到了玩具柜上面。可可兔和美
美鼠跳到了桌子下面。很多小朋友躲进
了卫生间里。

吼吼吼，吼吼吼——
喷火龙走进来了，啊啊啊，他想干什么？
要是他喷出火来，那多可怕！
喷火龙看看玩具柜上面的皮皮猴、蹦蹦蛙和
趴趴狗，又低下头看了看躲在桌子下面的可可兔
和美美鼠。

[P7] 他打开了一个盒子，把地球仪拿到盒子外面，
看了看，又把地球仪放回了盒子里面。

他把水杯架上面一排的水杯一个个拿起来看，又一个个放回去，
又把水杯架下面一排的水杯拿起来看，又一个个放回去。
他看起来在找什么。

可可兔想到自己带着奇妙宝盒，忽然不害怕了。她从桌子底下钻出来，对着喷火龙微笑：“你在找什么东西吗？”
喷火龙站在可可兔的前面看了看，又站到可可兔的后面看了看：“你是谁？”
“我是可可兔。”可可兔微笑着说。

[P8] “我找一个人，可他不叫你这个名字。”
喷火龙伤心地说，“我怎么找也找不到！”
“你找谁？把名字告诉我们，我们一起
帮你找。”其他小朋友也都围过来，他们都
愿意帮助喷火龙。

[P9] 喷火龙要找的人，名字叫朋友。
可可兔从口袋里拿出奇妙宝盒，送给喷火龙：“这是奇妙宝盒，只要你微笑，你就能找到朋友了。”
喷火龙接过盒子，笑了。
可可兔和小伙伴们先陪喷火龙来到教室前面玩滑滑梯，又陪喷火龙去教室后面玩蹦蹦床。
喷火龙已经找到了要找的人，对吧。

[P10] 幼儿园里有很多玩具，教室前面有滑梯和海洋球池，教室后面有秋千和蹦蹦床，请找到玩具贴纸，把它们贴在相应的地方。

可可兔和小朋友在玩游戏，请说一说，站在可可兔左边的是谁？站在可可兔右边的又是谁？请给左边的小朋友头顶上贴上星星，给右边的小朋友头顶上贴上一朵花。
full_text_en:
[P1] Montessori Children's Books
Good Education, Love Education
Math is Here!
Learn about spatial positions such as front/back, left/right
Understanding Positions
The Magical Treasure Box
Written by Zhong Linjiao, Illustrated by Su Hong
Jindun Publishing House

[P2] Keketou is going to school tomorrow.
Keketou's mom said, "You can make many friends in kindergarten." Keketou's dad said, "You'll have a lot of fun in kindergarten." 
Keketou really looked forward to tomorrow coming soon.

"Tomorrow" arrived. The weather was nice, but Keketou was not happy.
Sitting to Keketou's left was Meimei Mouse, who smiled warmly at Keketou: "Hello, your long ears are so beautiful!"
Keketou didn't like Meimei Mouse's pointy nose, so she pouted and didn't speak.
Meimei Mouse turned away and played "Rock, Paper, Scissors" with Papi Dog.

[P3] Sitting to the right of Keke Rabbit is Pipi Monkey, who smiles and greets Keke Rabbit:
"Hello, your long ears are so beautiful!"

Keke Rabbit doesn't like Pipi Monkey's long tail, so she pouts and says nothing.
Pipi Monkey walks away and goes to play with Bubu Frog, bouncing a small ball.

After class, some children are playing the game "Eagle Catching Chicks," some are building with blocks,
some are reading picture books... only Keke Rabbit sits alone on her seat.

[P4] After school, Rabbit Mom came to pick up Coco Rabbit.
Coco Rabbit pouted, "No one plays with me, and I haven't made any good friends."
Mom gently asked Coco Rabbit what had happened.
"Mimi Mouse and Pipi Monkey said my long ears are very beautiful."
"Then what did you do?"
"I don't like Mimi Mouse's sharp mouth, and I don't like Pipi Monkey's long tail. I didn't talk to them. Kindergarten is not fun, I don't want to go to kindergarten."
"Oh dear!" Rabbit Mom tapped her head, saying she had forgotten to give Coco Rabbit an important thing, which is why Coco Rabbit was unhappy at kindergarten.
Rabbit Mom went home, opened a big red box, and took out a small red box from inside.
What a treasure is this?
It turns out to be a magical box passed down from Grandma Rabbit, which can absorb happy energy.
However, only if Coco Rabbit smiles at others can she absorb the happy energy.

[P5] The next day, Coco Rabbit brought the magical box to kindergarten.
She smiled at Meimei Mouse on her left: "Meimei Mouse, your sharp mouth is great! Can it bite very hard things?"
"Haha, yes!" Meimei Mouse invited Coco Rabbit to play with building blocks, and they built a big castle.

Coco Rabbit smiled at Pippi Monkey on her right: "Pippi Monkey, your long tail is great! It must be able to hang from a tree and swing, right?"
"Haha, yes!" Pippi Monkey invited Coco Rabbit to play hide-and-seek.
Coco Rabbit hadn't found a place to hide yet, when a scary sound came from outside the classroom.
Roar roar roar……

[P6] Roar, roar, roar—
Ah, it's a fire-breathing dragon!
The children were scared. Pippi the monkey, Bubu the frog, and Papi the dog jumped onto the toy cabinet. Kokorabbit and Meimei mouse jumped under the table. Many children hid in the bathroom.

Roar, roar, roar—
The fire-breathing dragon came in, oh no, what does he want to do?
If he breathes fire, how terrible!
The fire-breathing dragon looked at Pippi the monkey, Bubu the frog, and Papi the dog on top of the toy cabinet, then lowered his head to look at Kokorabbit and Meimei mouse hiding under the table.

[P7] He opened a box, took the globe out, looked at it, and then put it back inside the box.

He took each cup from the top row of the cup rack, looked at them one by one, and put them back. Then he did the same with the bottom row. He seemed to be looking for something.

Keketu thought of her magical treasure box and suddenly felt brave. She crawled out from under the table, smiled at the fire-breathing dragon, and said, "Are you looking for something?"
The fire-breathing dragon looked at Keketu from the front, then moved behind her and asked, "Who are you?"
"I'm Keketu," Keketu smiled and said.

[P8] "I'm looking for someone, but he doesn't have this name."
Said the fire-breathing dragon sadly, "I can't find him no matter what!"
"Who are you looking for? Tell us the name, and we'll help you find him together."
The other children gathered around too, all willing to help the fire-breathing dragon.

[P9] The fire-breathing dragon was looking for someone named 'friend'.
Coco Rabbit took out the magical box from her pocket and gave it to the dragon: 'This is the magical box. As long as you smile, you can find friends.'
The dragon took the box and smiled.
Coco Rabbit and her friends first played on the slide in front of the classroom, then accompanied the dragon to play on the trampoline behind the classroom.
The dragon has already found the person it was looking for, right?

[P10] There are many toys in the kindergarten. In front of the classroom, there is a slide and a ball pool. Behind the classroom, there are swings and a trampoline. Please find the toy stickers and stick them in the correct places.

Keketu and the children are playing a game. Please say, who is standing to the left of Keketu? Who is standing to the right of Keketu? Please stick a star on the head of the child on the left, and a flower on the head of the child on the right.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本的封面页，标题为《了解方位：奇妙的宝盒》，作者为钟林皎，绘者为苏虹，由金盾出版社出版。页面上方有“数学来了！”的副标题，说明本书旨在帮助儿童认识前后、左右等空间方位。画面中央有兔子、小狗和青蛙三个卡通形象。
[P2] 本页描绘了可可兔期待上学，但第一天在幼儿园因不喜欢美美鼠的尖嘴巴而不开心，美美鼠只好转而和趴趴狗玩游戏。
[P3] 可可兔因不喜欢皮皮猴的长尾巴而拒绝交流，皮皮猴便离开和蹦蹦蛙玩耍。下课后，其他小朋友都在开心地玩游戏或看书，只有可可兔独自一人坐在座位上，显得孤单。
[P4] 放学后，可可兔向妈妈诉说在幼儿园因不喜欢同学的外貌而拒绝交流，导致孤单。兔妈妈回家后拿出外婆传下的奇妙宝盒，告诉可可兔只有对别人微笑，才能吸收快乐能量。
[P5] 第二天，可可兔带着奇妙宝盒来到幼儿园，主动向左边的美美鼠和右边的皮皮猴微笑并赞美他们的特点，两人分别邀请她一起玩积木和捉迷藏，但捉迷藏时教室外突然传来可怕的声音。
[P6] 教室里突然出现一只喷火龙，小朋友们吓得四处躲藏：皮皮猴、蹦蹦蛙和趴趴狗跳上玩具柜，可可兔和美美鼠躲到桌子下，其他孩子则躲进卫生间。喷火龙走进来，环顾四周，让孩子们更加害怕。
[P7] 喷火龙在教室里翻找物品，可可兔因带着奇妙宝盒而鼓起勇气，从桌子下钻出，微笑着与喷火龙对话，询问它在找什么。
[P8] 喷火龙在教室里寻找一个人却找不到，感到伤心。可可兔和其他小朋友主动围过来，询问它在找谁，并表示愿意帮忙寻找。
[P9] 可可兔将外婆传下的奇妙宝盒送给喷火龙，并告诉它微笑就能找到朋友。随后，可可兔和小伙伴们陪喷火龙一起玩滑滑梯和蹦蹦床，喷火龙最终找到了它要找的人——朋友。
[P10] 本页为互动游戏页，左侧要求将滑梯、海洋球池、秋千、蹦蹦床贴纸贴到对应位置；右侧要求识别可可兔左右两侧的小朋友，并在他们头顶贴上星星或花朵。
